surface_strategies.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#08090A]/80 border-b border-[#22252A] sticky top-0 z-50
surface_strategies.cards: bg-[#121417] border border-[#22252A] shadow-none transition-all duration-300

components.buttons: h-12 px-6 py-3 font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-xs flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300
components.secondary_button: bg-transparent border border-[#22252A] text-white hover:bg-[#121417] hover:border-[#404552]
components.inputs: h-12 bg-[#08090A] border border-[#22252A] text-white focus:border-[#0052FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0052FF] rounded-none px-4
components.badges: px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase border border-[#22252A] bg-[#121417] text-[#8F95A3]
components.shadcn_overrides: Do not use standard card shadows. Flatten cards. Use sharp edges or max 4px radius. Override default neutral borders with #22252A.

icons.style: duotone for marketing landing page sections, regular weight for data-dense dashboards.

image_urls.description: Abstract futuristic cyber landscape, used for the main landing page hero section. Add an overlay of bg-black/60 to ensure text readability.
Abstract flowing lines, used to add visual interest behind the AI Domain Valuation tool.
Minimalist dark architecture, used for Pricing Plans or About section to convey premium authority.

media.logos_instructions: Use 'react-icons/fa' or 'react-icons/si' for all payment and crypto logos (e.g., SiStripe, FaBitcoin, SiTether, SiGodaddy). Do not use image placeholders for logos.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Ensure APCA contrast is met. Body text #8F95A3 against #08090A is legible. Hover states must explicitly define text colors.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, domain listings, tabs, AI valuation triggers) MUST use data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Write components in .js/.jsx. Do NOT output .tsx files.
Always run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react react-icons framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react` before starting.
Include the Google Fonts import link for Outfit, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono in your index.html or root CSS.
For the domain marketplace grid, use a dense 'Bento Box' or 'Control Room' grid layout. Display TLDs (.com, .ai) in sharp monochromatic badges.
AI Valuation Component: Must use the 'Tracing Beam' surface strategy (animated border) to emphasize the AI brain processing.
Use glassmorphism (bg-[#08090A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#22252A]) for the sticky navigation header.
Dashboard: Strip out standard 'Vercel-like' soft shadows. Use the 'Grid Borders' strategy (border-collapse, border-r border-b on items) to create a 'Command Center' feel.
Wallet & Crypto: Color-code currencies subtly. USD (Green hint), BTC (Orange hint), USDT (Teal hint) but keeping the overall UI dark, rigid, and monochrome.
Do not use generic font families like Inter for headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Never use pure black (#000000) or white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds. Base background is #08090A.
No placeholder images. Use provided media URLs in the media object.
